title: NIST WebBook: Potassium is K, molecular weight 39.0983 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Potassium as K, molecular weight 39.0983 amu, CAS 7440-09-7.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Potassium, CAS Registry Number 7440-09-7, lists molecular formula K and molecular weight 39.0983 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 38.96370668 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/K. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
